nom: Drunk Elephant Beste No. 9 Jelly Cleanser

segments.oily: The one reviewer who self-identifies as having extremely oily, acne-prone skin calls the cleanser amazing and non-stripping, and a separate detailed review recommends it for oily-to-combination skin since it cleanses without leaving skin greasy.
segments.dry: Reviewers with dry skin, including one living in a desert climate whose skin is normally dry, report the cleanser does not over-dry and leaves skin feeling moisturized rather than tight.
segments.combination: Multiple reviewers with combination skin, some describing both dry and oily areas on their face, say it balances their skin without drying it out, causing breakouts, or leaving it oily.
segments.sensitive: A very large number of self-described sensitive-skin reviewers, several also managing eczema-prone or acne-prone skin, report no irritation, stinging, or dryness on the face; one reviewer's eczema-prone hand skin was irritated by the product even though her face tolerated it well.
segments.mature: The one reviewer who describes her skin as aging, alongside combination, says it gives her the moisture she needs at her age without drying her out.

concerns.aging: The one reviewer who describes her skin as aging says the cleanser is gentle enough for mature skin while still providing the moisture she needs, without drying her out.
concerns.dehydration: Reviewers overwhelmingly report the cleanser hydrates and never strips or tightens the skin, including several with chronically dry or desert-climate skin who specifically note the absence of a tight, dry after-feel; no reviewer in this set describes the cleanser itself as drying.
concerns.redness: Numerous reviewers, including one managing rosacea, report visibly reduced redness with regular use, sometimes noticing the difference within days; none in this set report increased redness.
concerns.barrier: Several reviewers credit the cleanser with maintaining or restoring their skin barrier, including one who uses it to recover after over-using actives, and note its balanced pH does not strip the barrier.
concerns.blemishes: Most acne-prone reviewers report clearer skin, fewer breakouts, and reduced whiteheads or blackheads with regular use; one reviewer reports the opposite, saying it broke her out badly.
concerns.oiliness: Reviewers with oily or combination skin say it removes excess oil and daily sunscreen without leaving skin greasy or triggering new breakouts, including one with extremely oily, acne-prone skin who calls it amazing.

extraits.titre: A great solution for aging, sensitive combination skin
extraits.texte: I have very finicky combination skin, so this cleanser is the ticket for me. It doesn't dry me out but still provides the moisture I do need at my age. It rinses well, is gentle on my aging skin, and it doesn't take much at all to get the job done. It really is about the quality and getting what you pay for in the long run.

Works like a charm to cleanse, but not dry out my combination, acne, prone, congested skin. I'm happy to have found it. Now I'm looking for a way to eat out my hyper pigmentation that won't break out.

I'm really impressed with my Drunk Elephant Beste No 9 Jelly Cleanser that was gifted by Drunk Elephant! It leaves my skin feeling incredibly soft and thoroughly clean. Since I started using it, I've noticed a significant reduction in acne, and my skin looks much calmer with less redness.

I highly recommend this cleanser. My skin is pretty sensitive and dry, so I've struggled to find a cleanser that will clean my skin without drying it out or making me break out. But this cleanser has been amazing!! It leaves my skin feeling soft and clean, without destroying my skins moisture barrier. I love this cleanser! Gifted by drunkelephant

This product has helped a lot with ny redness and dry skin. I live in the desert and my skin always feels dry but not since I have been using the Jelly cleanser. It cleans your skin without over drying it. Would 1000% recommend. Gifted by drunk elephant
